intro: Jennea Cannon is a respected human mage trainer residing within the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. She oversees the education of novice sorcerers, guiding them through foundational studies and investigating disturbances in the flow of local arcane energies. Through her tasks, she tests whether apprentices have the discipline needed to control magic without being consumed by it.

p: Positioned atop the spiral walkway of the Wizard's Sanctum, Jennea Cannon stands as one of the primary mentors for arcane practitioners entering Stormwind. Rather than merely drilling spells into pupils, she emphasizes caution and self-control. To non-mages passing through the tower, she offers a sharp warning: unchecked magic will burn the untrained, a truth novice spellcasters learn quickly under her tutelage.

Jennea believes magical theory must be tested by real-world observation. She frequently dispatches promising apprentices outside the city walls, sending them to examine sites such as Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest to understand how natural water sources interact with arcane resonance. As students advance, she tests their resolve by directing them to investigate disruptions at the Blue Recluse or gathering volatile reagents for crafting their first true wizard's implements.

While Jennea handles early instruction and local affairs, she knows when an apprentice has outgrown her syllabus. Once an initiate demonstrates true potential, she directs them up the hierarchy of the Sanctum to High Sorcerer Andromath or even beyond the kingdom's borders to reclusive practitioners like Tabetha deep in the Dustwallow Marsh.
